title: Tunisian Italian Brik
description: A fusion of Italian flavors with a Tunisian twist, featuring crispy brik pastry filled with savory meat and spices.

ingredients.name: ground meat
ingredients.notes: beef or a combination of beef and pork

ingredients.name: tunisian spices
ingredients.notes: a blend of cumin, coriander, and paprika

instructions: Thaw brik pastry according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, cook ground meat over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in tunisian spices and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Season the meat mixture with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the meat mixture to a bowl and stir in crumbled feta cheese.
Cut brik pastry sheets into squares and place a tablespoon of the meat mixture in the center of each square.
Fold the pastry squares into triangles and press the edges together to seal.
Brush the tops of the brik with a little bit of olive oil and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
